review_description: There has been nothing but drama the whole process. The salesman was great until the problems started. They installed the solar panels and not the inverter. Came back 10 weeks later to install the inverter. Great we now had solar. NOT.The electrician failed to lodge the paper work required to install. Ergon was going to fine us as it was an illegal installation , this was 6 months after installationNow roll on another month and Ergon turns up as the meter is not compatable.Ergon Energy informs us that this is the most difficult company to deal with.also Pioneer Solar told Ergon that it was our fault...HOW. They did not lodge the paperwork.We have now paid 7 months of payments with no return from our solarWe have lost over 3000 units into the gridThese people do not return calls and you are forever chasing them up.Stay away

Origin Energy has very much disappointed us.  Before we finally decided to proceed with the PV installation, we talked by phone with a member of the Solar division of Origin who assured us we would be paid 14 cents FIT.  We find now that we are only going to get 7 cents.  Obviously, this has seriously affected our pay-back calculations adding almost another year to the pay-back period.  We find ourselves in a he-said she-said situation and stuck with the 7 cents FIT.  Origin did however increase the level of discount to include the supply rate as well as any electricity rate.  We wanted to stay with Origin, but will consider switching after our next account.

Shocking, is the best way to describe it.  In the 3 years I have had this system, it has broken down 5 times.  Each time it takes usually a week and a half to get someone here to repair it.  I have had the inverter completely replaced twice.  I'm often lied to with the promise of a call back, that doesn't happen or the promise to send a repair person, who doesn't turn up.  My recommendation to anyone considering Pioneer Solar is avoid them!
